data.title: JCR Eurasia Affirms Erciyas Çelik Boru’s BBB- Rating with Stable Outlook
data.description:
Erciyas Celik Boru Sanayi A.S. ( (TR:ERCB) ) has provided an update.

JCR Eurasia Rating has affirmed Erciyas Çelik Boru Sanayi A.Ş.’s Long-Term National Institution Credit Rating at BBB- (tr) with a Stable outlook, alongside stable short-term and international ratings. The affirmation reflects the company’s sectoral and geographical diversity, sustainable production focus, and strong governance, which help offset recent operational and market headwinds.

The rating report highlights declining sales and EBITDA in the first half of 2026, worsening leverage and negative free cash flow in 2025 driven by working capital loans and project financing needs. Rising financing costs, increased related-party receivables and subdued demand in Türkiye and Europe, combined with global geopolitical risks, are seen as ongoing pressures, but not sufficient to trigger an immediate downgrade.

data.title: Pharming Wins FDA Priority Review for Lower-Dose Joenja in Younger APDS Patients
data.description:
Pharming Group ( (NL:PHARM) ) has issued an update.

Pharming Group has secured U.S. FDA acceptance and Priority Review for a supplemental New Drug Application seeking approval of lower-dose Joenja for children aged four and older with APDS who weigh between 13 kg and 27 kg. The filing, backed by positive Phase III data showing correction of key immune defects, aims to extend Joenja’s reach to smaller pediatric patients currently excluded from treatment, with a PDUFA decision expected by January 30, 2027.

This regulatory milestone builds on recent FDA expansions of Joenja’s label to younger and lighter patients and reinforces Pharming’s position in rare disease immunology. If approved, the broader pediatric indication could deepen Joenja’s penetration in the ultra‑rare APDS market, improve access for families facing long diagnostic delays and limited options, and enhance Pharming’s commercial footprint in its core rare immunodeficiency franchise.
